rule: for each polarity, for each unordered pair of parties on DIFFERENT sides whose refs both resolve to principles.json rows (principle or obligation) -> one edge carrying the polarity id and its mediating variable. Same-side pairs produce NO edge (237-T finding 4: tn-19's three persuasion principles are one side). Stubs and rulings produce NO edge (237-T finding 3: an edge needs a register node at both ends). This is a VIEW: the node is the home (s238-D1).

edges.mediating_variable: LAYER: convention governs MECHANISM (where things are, how they behave), distinctiveness governs SIGNAL (which single element carries the moment). Also brand mandate.
WHO ABSORBS IT: user expertise and task frequency. Also whether the removed complexity is REGULATED (then it cannot be relocated off-screen at all).
TASK CRITICALITY and whether the user believes work is being done on their behalf. Search and underwriting benefit from visible work; a toggle does not.

WHO IS MEASURING: in evaluation, aesthetics is a confound to control; in shipping, it is a benefit to bank.
INTERRUPTION COST vs INFORMATION VALUE: how reversible is the thing the user is doing, and how time-critical is the news.
WHOSE INTEREST: goal-gradient helps a user finish a task they chose; the artificial-progress variant serves the business.
WHETHER THE REMOVED THING WAS REAL: was an option deleted, or moved out of sight?
PREFERENCE CLARITY and EXPERTISE — the moderators Scheibehenne et al. identified. Novices with unclear preferences benefit from curation; experts do not.
NEITHER APPLIES: both are recall-capacity claims and a visible menu is a recognition task.
FREQUENCY OF USE per element, and whether recall would be from the same screen or from elsewhere.
TRUTH and REVERSIBILITY: a real count shown honestly is persuasion; a fabricated or non-reversible one is prohibited design.

REGULATORY CONTEXT plus DECISION MOMENT. Disclosure must be present AT the decision, not one click away in a PDF.
STRENGTH ORDER: common region beats proximity when they conflict. So a keyline in the wrong place silently redefines the group.
ACTION CONSEQUENCE: acknowledgement is always immediate; CELEBRATION is proportional.
COST OF THE SECOND ROUTE: does it change the mental model, or just the entry point?
CONSENT vs CONVENIENCE and REVERSIBILITY. A default on a data-protection choice is unlawful; a default on units or theme is a kindness.
LOAD TYPE: extraneous load (remove freely) vs germane/intrinsic state the task needs held (must stay visible).
WHETHER THE PAGE HAS STRUCTURE: the F appears when structure is absent. It is a symptom, not a target.
